title: From the top 10 instance display names with the largest instance-memory ran
question: From the top 10 instance display names with the largest instance-memory range (in MB) among instances in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', show each display name’s memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total vCPUs, and total memory, and also include (for the same display names) the average, variance, and maximum instance memory (in MB) computed only from instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and where the average memory is greater than 75% of the maximum memory for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MAX(memory_mb) - MIN(memory_mb) AS memory_range,
         VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS memory_variance,
         STDDEV(memory_mb) AS memory_stddev,
         SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus,
         SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name
  ORDER BY memory_range DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
meta_stats AS (
  SELECT i.display_name,
         AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory,
         VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_memory,
         MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    AND i.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM top10)
  GROUP BY i.display_name
  HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0.75 * MAX(i.memory_mb)
)
SELECT t.display_name,
       t.memory_range,
       t.memory_variance,
       t.memory_stddev,
       t.total_vcpus,
       t.total_memory,
       m.avg_memory,
       m.variance_memory,
       m.max_memory
FROM top10 t
LEFT JOIN meta_stats m ON t.display_name = m.display_name
ORDER BY t.memory_range DESC

         (i.uuid IN (SELECT instance_uuid FROM instance_system_metadata WHERE `key`='image_image_type')) AS has_meta
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone='flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
),
top AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MAX(memory_mb)-MIN(memory_mb) AS mem_range,
         VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS mem_var,
         STDDEV(memory_mb) AS mem_std,
         SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus,
         SUM(memory_mb) AS total_mem
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name
  ORDER BY mem_range DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
meta_stats AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         AVG(memory_mb) AS meta_avg,
         VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS meta_var,
         MAX(memory_mb) AS meta_max
  FROM base
  WHERE has_meta=1
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT t.display_name,
       t.mem_range,
       t.mem_var,
       t.mem_std,
       t.total_vcpus,
       t.total_mem,
       CASE WHEN m.meta_avg > 0.75*m.meta_max THEN m.meta_avg END AS meta_avg,
       CASE WHEN m.meta_avg > 0.75*m.meta_max THEN m.meta_var END AS meta_var,
       CASE WHEN m.meta_avg > 0.75*m.meta_max THEN m.meta_max END AS meta_max
FROM top t
LEFT JOIN meta_stats m ON m.display_name=t.display_name
ORDER BY t.mem_range DESC;
